name: openoutreach_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the openoutreach capability.

prompts.name: lead_identification_prompt
prompts.template: Describe my product: {product_description}. Find people who fit this profile and explain why.
prompts.use_case: Small and medium-sized B2B companies looking to automate lead generation

prompts.name: email_personalization_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a personalized outreach email for the lead {lead_name} explaining why {product_description} would benefit them.
prompts.use_case: Sales teams wanting to generate targeted outreach lists with rationale
